HER3 is a critical component of HER2-driven cancers and is a key target for therapeutic intervention.
the kinase-inactive receptor HER3 is a key mediator of the resistance of human breast tumour cells to HER family TKI treatment.

The main takeaway from our work is that
HER3 is a critical mediator of HER family TKI resistance and is a promising therapeutic target.
the HER3 receptor is a major driver of the oncogenic signalling in HER2-amplified tumours and is therefore a major target for the development of novel therapies.
HER3 is not just an innocent bystander in HER2-driven cancers, but rather a major contributor to their oncogenesis and drug resistance.
